The Restaurant at Kellogg Ranch is getting some well-deserved attention.

The Inland Valley Daily Bulletin recently visited RKR to see how Collins College students gain hands-on experience running a full-service restaurant. Students rotate through roles across the operation, from food preparation and service to leadership and management.

The Restaurant at Kellogg Ranch at The Collins College of Hospitality Management, Cal Poly Pomona has been named an OpenTable Diners’ Choice for “Great for Scenic Views” in Los Angeles!

Overlooking the hills of Diamond Bar, the RKR is more than a beautiful place to dine — it is a hands-on learning environment where Collins College students rotate through management, service and other essential restaurant operations.

This recognition reflects the care and hard work our students, faculty and staff bring to every service. Congratulations to the entire RKR team and thank you to our community of OpenTable diners.
